text: Implemented shared deterministic MVPA parity fixtures and MvpaParitySuite covering RDM squared/normalized/Euclidean/correlation estimands, crossnobis raw vs feature-normalized distances, partial RSA scoring with labeled controls, centroid classifier probability oracles, ridge LDA probability oracle, and a lightweight deterministic benchmark harness with explicit checksums and injected clock. Documented fixture-generation semantics in tools/r-parity/mvpa-fixtures.md and module docs. Verified with sbt mvpaJVM/test mvpaJS/test, sbt compileAll, and sbt testAll.
